page.notes: The letter ט at the head of the section is a bare letter, so it is written as a paragraph, not a heading. No running head is printed. The catchword טיב stands at the lower right and is also given in the bottom margin. Several Hebrew words have vowel points and small signs that are hard to read at this scan resolution, so some forms may differ slightly; the Hebrew was copied from the visible letters. "Jef.43.27" is printed that way and was kept as is. The entry for טבע and the "טפטף" line have uncertain vowel points that were not marked with [?]. Marks at the foot of the page are ink spots and were left out.
